items.text: Bears planning to start QB Caleb Williams vs Falcons after full week of practice with no setbacks from torn hamstring (missed prior 3 games); was listed questionable but took starter reps.
items.why: Full practice week, no setbacks, starter reps confirmed by sources.
items.implication: Upgrade for CHI pass-catchers (Odunze, Moore, Loveland); solid QB streamer spot vs ATL.
items.opportunity: Full dropback volume and designed runs possible; boosts all Bears skill players.

items.text: Eagles officially placed QB Jalen Hurts on injured reserve due to a superficial blood clot in his calf after consultations with doctors; he is out for the foreseeable future (at least 4 games). Tanner McKee will start.
items.why: Blood clot movement confirmed; health priority after multiple expert consults.
items.implication: McKee starts ROS short-term; Eagles pass-catchers retain value but QB downgrade; no Hurts rushing upside.
items.opportunity: Increased passing volume potential to DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks if McKee plays clean; thin RB room amplifies pass game.

items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown from IR to 53-man roster; he is expected to play Sunday vs Jets after returning to practice this week from high-ankle sprain.
items.why: Cleared practice ramp; official activation and expected to play.
items.implication: Immediate WR2/flex start; boosts NE passing attack vs Jets.
items.opportunity: High target share expected on return in favorable matchup; monitor snap count but full role likely.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT for Week 6 (hamstring); missed practice all week after exiting Week 4 early. Will Shipley also OUT.
items.why: No practice participation Wed-Fri; official OUT designation.
items.implication: PHI RB room thin (Dameon Pierce likely lead); heavy pass-game reliance with McKee.
items.opportunity: Elevated carries/targets for remaining RBs and pass-catchers; reverse any prior Barkley start plans.

items.text: Pick up Tanner McKee in any league needing QB if available; he will be a lot better than expected. Not worried about any Eagles skill players with McKee under center (may take moment for reps in offense).
items.why: Hurts IR; McKee can play; skill players protected.
items.implication: Stream McKee; hold/start PHI weapons confidently.
items.opportunity: Pass-catcher stability despite QB change; thin RB helps aerial attack.

items.text: Assuming AJ Brown active for Patriots he'll be active for me; starting him as WR2 wherever rostered.
items.why: Return from high-ankle; expected play vs Jets.
items.opportunity: Immediate target earner in NE offense.

items.text: On ETR report: Unclear still on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren (groin) Friday Q add. Many Qs lean probable (Caleb, Metcalf, Olave, Dowdle). PIT thin at WR (no Pittman/Wilson/Skowronek) so heavy 2-WR Metcalf + Bernard. PHI McKee has 4th-string RB but healthy top-4 pass-catchers (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon).
items.why: Practice trends and report parsing; PIT personnel notes; PHI depth context.
items.implication: Favor probable Qs; Metcalf target monster in 2-WR; start PHI pass-catchers confidently with McKee; monitor Henderson closely (doubt high-ankle severity given practice).
items.opportunity: Metcalf route/target spike; PHI WR/TE full roles; Warren Q risk but Friday add noted.
items.conflict: Henderson ankle doubt low per practice but initial multi-week reports conflicted.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT for Sunday.
items.implication: Ravens QB downgrade; check backup and impact on Flowers/Henry/Andrews.
items.opportunity: Potential change in play-calling volume/style for BAL skill players.

items.text: Rashee Rice listed OUT for Sunday along with Tyquan Thornton.
items.implication: KC WR targets consolidate to Worthy/others; Mahomes volume shift.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Xavier Worthy and remaining KC pass-catchers.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT (with AD Mitchell).
items.implication: NYJ RB committee or backup lead; Wilson target bump possible.
items.opportunity: Increased carries for remaining Jets RBs; check depth chart.

items.implication: HOU/DET? Wait list has HOU but classic DET; anyway elevated role for handcuff/backup.
items.opportunity: More carries for remaining RBs (e.g. if DET then Gibbs full load).

items.text: Ravens officially activated WR Ja’Kobi Lane from IR; expected to play Sunday vs Browns.
items.implication: Depth WR add for BAL; monitor role behind Flowers etc with Lamar out.
items.opportunity: Potential rotational snaps/routes in depleted or adjusted offense.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans (vs WSH WR4), Drake London (vs CHI WR6), George Kittle (vs WSH TE3) due to Washington defense buffet for pass-catchers and strong usage/matchups.
items.why: WSH defense soft vs WR/TE; London/Golden usage bankable; Evans/Kittle matchup nightmare for defense.
items.opportunity: High target/red-zone potential vs leaky secondary.

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams (vs ARI RB5), Javonte Williams (@ GB RB8), Rhamondre Stevenson (vs NYJ RB9) for elite/recent volume and soft run defenses; Javonte goal-line role key.
items.why: Volume + leaking run Ds; Kyren elite usage; Javonte GL work.
